description: Single-port multi-protocol proxy gateway - single-container form. On Heroku only the HTTP-carried protocols work (admin console, HTTP proxy, VLESS/Trojan over WebSocket); raw-TCP protocols (SOCKS5, SSH, bare Shadowsocks/VLESS) cannot pass Heroku's router.

DIRECT_ALLOW_PRIVATE.description: Set to 1 only if the node must reach private / LAN addresses directly. Leave unset otherwise.

name: xmagic
